title: Register the track color
prompt: The CMS wrote `12px` into the **Lightning Talks** card's `--track-color`, so its border and badge lose their color. Register `--track-color` with `@property` as a `<color>` that **inherits** and has an initial value of `#64748b` (slate grey). The Design (`#db2777`) and Performance (`#0891b2`) cards must keep their colors, and the broken card should fall back to slate grey.
hints: The syntax for a color is the string `"<color>"`, with the quotes.
explanation: Once `--track-color` is registered as a `<color>`, the browser checks every value against that type. `12px` fails, so on the Lightning Talks card the property behaves as unset; because it inherits, it takes the parent's value, and the parent only has the initial value, `#64748b`. Valid track colors pass through and are now stored as real colors, which is why `getComputedStyle` reports `rgb(219, 39, 119)` instead of the text `#db2777`. Without registration, `12px` was substituted into the `border-inline-start` shorthand, making the whole declaration invalid at computed-value time; every longhand reset to its initial value, including `border-style: none`, so the border vanished.

checks.bad-value-falls-back: The card with a bad value falls back to slate grey
